title: Efficient enrichment cloning of TAL effector genes from Xanthomonas
author: Tran, Doucouré, et al.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare total genomic DNA from the two African X. oryzae strains using the Qiagen midi‑prep protocol for bacteria with Genomic‑tips 100/G; after purification, resuspend the DNA in 500 µL double‑distilled H₂O, aliquot into several Eppendorf tubes and store at –30 °C.

steps.title: Extract plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate plasmid DNA from the same strains using either the QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit or the Qiagen Plasmid Kit for midiprep, following the manufacturers’ instructions.
